summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for Tavant AI OpenView. All major flows pass: Home dashboard renders with all 6 KPI cards & charts, KPI deep-linking to /explore with pre-applied status filters works, capability tag cloud navigates with capability query param, Explore page search/sort/filters all functional, Project Detail navigation, Open Assets project-scoping, Asset Library tabs (All/Accelerator/Demo/Prompt Library/Template/Code), Asset detail page, global header search dropdown shows matching projects and assets, Submit form creates new initiative with proper navigation to /projects/proj-<timestamp>, localStorage persistence survives page reload, edit flow at /submit/proj-001 pre-populates LoanLens data and saves with new name, Onboarding & Leadership pages render, Reset demo data works. No backend; frontend-only with localStorage key tavant-openview-v1.

issues: Recharts emits repeated console warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' when ResponsiveContainer mounts. Cosmetic only; charts render correctly after layout. Consider giving SectionBlock children an explicit min-height or use aspect ratio to silence the warning.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Suppress Recharts width/height warnings by ensuring ResponsiveContainer parent has non-zero dimensions on first paint (e.g., add min-h to chart wrappers). No functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: DataContext localStorage write is unguarded — wrap JSON.parse / setItem in try/catch to avoid breaking the app if localStorage is full or corrupted (recommendation; not tested broken).
MetricCard navigation builds `?demo=true` for 'Demo Ready', and Explore hydrates demo=true -> Yes correctly; consistent.
Submit page generates id as `proj-${Date.now()}` which is fine for a frontend-only mock but would clash with a real backend later.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings indicate parents momentarily have 0 dimensions; consider giving the wrapping div an explicit min-height.
seed_data_creation: Created one test initiative 'Test Initiative QA' via Submit form during the run. Reset demo data button restores seed at the end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully frontend with DataContext localStorage key 'tavant-openview-v1'. Clear localStorage between sessions for clean tests. All testids in problem statement are present and working. The only non-functional issue is a Recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height warning on initial mount.
